rules.arrival: correct if declared within 30 m of the destination
rules.cue: on time if the first cue comes 10 m .. max(60 m, 10 s) before the turn
rules.drive: DMN open-map route, 10.0 m/s (3.0 m/s in the last 40 m), 1 fix/s, noise 3.0 m / 4.0 deg, accuracy 5.0 m, seed sha256('RUN-C:<id>:<scenario>')
rules.dropout: no fixes for 25 s from 45% of the route, then a 60 m jump fix and a 50 m-accuracy fix
rules.wrong_turn: first junction between 35% and 75% of the route with another legal public road (residential or bigger, no access tags) continuing >= 200 m (straightest such road, off the route); reference reroute point: first segment >= 5 m after 120 m on it
